Our Story

About Sangeet Saadhna

Founded by rasikas and music educators, Sangeet Saadhna is a volunteer-driven sabha nurturing Indian classical traditions in Central Jersey.

Share your story or host a bhajan with us.

We welcome collaborations with gurus, schools, cultural organizations, and venues that align with our mission.

Collaborate with us

What began as a living-room bhajan sandhya has grown into a thriving sabha where artists, students, and devotees gather every month to celebrate the traditions of Hindustani and Carnatic music.

The community is sustained by volunteers who coordinate programming, curate artists, welcome new families, and document each gathering. Our values are rooted in respect for the guru-shishya parampara, openness to experimentation, and a deep love of raag and taal.

What we do

  • Host monthly bhajans featuring vocalists and instrumentalists
  • Provide stage exposure and mentorship for youth and emerging artists
  • Document performances to grow an accessible archive of community talent
“Sangeet Saadhna has become a second home for our musical family. The warmth, the rigor, and the rasa we experience each month keep us inspired.” — Community member
